test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
Given below are six sentences A-F, of which A and F are static and B-E have been jumbled. Pick the option that gives the correct order of the jumbled sentences.

A. The King and Queen of Siam had several daughters.

B. So, the King named his daughters January, February, March till he came to the youngest whom he named September.

C. The princesses were very proud of their parrots and spent time teaching them to talk.

D. One year on his birthday, the King gave each of his daughters a green parrot in a cage.

E. The Queen said it confused her to remember so many names.

F. In a short while all the parrots could say “God save the King”.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'AEBDCF'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sentence A** talks about the **'several daughters'** of the King and Queen of Siam, *directly connecting** *****sentence E** which talks about*** the Queen who gets confused remembering so many names***.
 
• **Sentence B** follows sentence **E **telling us *the names of the daughters of the Kind and Queen.*
 
• **Sentence D** and **sentence C** **follows** sentence** B respectively**, as in sentence **D** we get to know that* the King gifted each of his daughters a green parrot on his birthday* and in sentence **C** we get to know that *the princesses were proud of their gift and spent most of their time teaching the parrots to talk.*
 
• Hence the correct sequence is **AEBDCF.**
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **option 1.**
